business_summary: Zhongtai Futures Company Limited provides brokerage services for commodity futures brokerage, financial futures brokerage. The company operates through Brokerage Business, Risk Management Business, Asset Management, and Other Businesses segments. The company provides consulting services in futures investments, asset management, basis trading, warehouse receipt service, cooperative hedging, and information technology consulting services, as well as engages in the market making business, over-the-counter derivatives business, and other business activities. The company was formerly known as LUZHENG FUTURES Company Limited and changed its name to Zhongtai Futures Company Limited in March 2022. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Jinan, the People's Republic of China. Zhongtai Futures Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Zhongtai Securities Co., Ltd.
business_summary_ko: Zhongtai Futures Company Limited는 상품 선물 중개, 금융 선물 중개에 대한 중개 서비스를 제공합니다. 회사는 중개 사업, 위험 관리 사업, 자산 관리 및 기타 사업 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 회사는 선물투자, 자산관리, 기초거래, 창고영수증, 협력헤징, 정보기술 컨설팅 등의 서비스를 제공하고 있으며, 시장조성사업, 장외파생상품사업, 기타 사업활동을 영위하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 LUZHENG FUTURES Company Limited로 알려졌으며 2022년 3월에 Zhongtai Futures Company Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. 이 회사는 1995년에 설립되었으며 중화인민공화국 지난에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Zhongtai Futures Company Limited는 Zhongtai Securities Co., Ltd.의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
